name: Press Review
author: dariodda

sections.description:
Press Review creates a PDF magazine-style daily review from your latest WordPress posts.

The first page contains a three-column index with featured images, titles, authors, dates and excerpts. Each preview title links directly to the full article page inside the PDF. Every full article starts on a new page, while long articles can continue across additional pages.

The plugin also includes a final editorial page where you can add the director name and the editorial staff. A shortcode lets you publish a download link anywhere on your site.

Press Review is designed for blogs, online magazines, local newspapers and editorial websites that want to create a simple daily PDF edition from existing WordPress posts.

Upgrade to Press Review PRO for advanced publishing features: https://opusdev.eu/it/prodotto/press-review-for-news-site-and-blog/

Features

  • Generate a daily PDF from WordPress posts
  • Stable multilingual PDF labels with backend language override
  • Three-column first-page article index
  • Selectable first-page title/logo display
  • Clickable article titles linking to internal article pages
  • One article per page, with continuation support for long articles
  • Running editorial header from page two onward
  • Editable final editorial page
  • Shortcode: [odprv_press_review]
  • No external service required

Included Languages

This version includes stable language presets for the current lightweight PDF engine:

  • Site language fallback
  • English
  • Italian
  • Spanish
  • French
  • German
  • Portuguese
  • Brazilian Portuguese
  • Dutch
  • Polish
  • Romanian
  • Turkish
  • Swedish
  • Danish
  • Swahili

Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, Greek and Ukrainian require an advanced Unicode/CJK/RTL PDF engine and are not included in this version.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate Press Review from the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Press Review in the WordPress admin menu
  4. Select your logo, masthead settings and PDF language
  5. Click Generate PDF
  6. Use [odprv_press_review] to publish the latest PDF link
sections.faq:
Can I choose the PDF language?

Yes. You can follow the WordPress site language or override it from the Press Review settings page.

Does the plugin translate my post content automatically?

No. Press Review translates plugin labels and PDF interface text. Article titles and content remain as written in WordPress.

Does the logo appear on every page?

The selected logo can appear on the first page and as a small editorial header from page two onward.

How many columns are used on the first page?

The first page uses three columns.

Can I choose the posts manually?

Not in this free version. The plugin automatically uses the latest posts from the current day, with fallback to the latest published posts.

Are internal links supported?

Yes. Clicking a preview title on the first page opens the related article page inside the PDF.

Is there a PRO version?

Yes. You can upgrade from the admin screen or visit https://opusdev.eu/it/prodotto/press-review-for-news-site-and-blog/
sections.changelog:
1.1.11

  • Added WordPress.org-ready assets for icon and banner.
  • Added Upgrade to PRO link in the admin page.
  • Added AJAX nonce validation for logo preview requests.
  • Updated GPLv2+ licensing files and readme metadata.

1.1.10

  • Restored full article text justification in stable columns.
  • Kept stable Latin-based PDF text output.

1.1.9

  • Restored the backend PDF language selector clearly near the top of settings.
  • Kept editorial team page translation and staff line formatting fixes.

1.1.8

  • Fixed editorial team page translations according to the selected backend language.
  • Preserved Staff / Journalists line breaks in the final PDF page.

1.1.7

  • Improved article text wrapping and stable column justification to prevent overlap between columns.

1.1.6

  • Restored stable PDF text encoding for Latin-based output.
  • Removed additional complex-script languages from the Free selector.
  • Prevented non-embedded Unicode font fallback from producing random symbols.

1.1.4

  • Removed CJK/RTL languages from the Free selector to prevent broken PDF output with the lightweight PDF engine.
  • Added clearer Free/PRO language support notes.

1.0.8

  • Improved full justification in article columns using manual word spacing.
  • Improved line wrapping measurement for newspaper-style columns.

1.0.7

  • Added backend setting to choose title, logo or both in the first-page masthead.
  • Added editorial header from page two onward.
  • Improved full justification and article metadata placement.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
